summary: # Flow chart syntax ## Nodes A node is the most basic building block in a flow chart. Node definitions consist of a name followed by an optional set of properties. For example, `Start` is the name of below node and it has an `shape` property which is set to `oval`. ``` Start [shape: oval] ``` Node names are required to be unique. Nodes support `shape`, `icon`, `color`, and `label` properties. More on properties below. ## Groups
